notes: §1985:VIII.4.6.2 prints "REWRITE record-name-1 [ FROM identifier-1 ] [ INVALID KEY ... ] [ NOT INVALID KEY ... ] [ END-REWRITE ]" in that sequence (§1985:IV.2.1). rewriteStatement parses the superset, SequentialIoBinder#BindRewrite routes a relative file to KeyedIoBinder#BindRewrite, and at 85 VisitRewriteStatement refuses the word RECORD (PB5159, landed: the prior PARTIAL), VisitConditionalPhrases refuses NOT INVALID KEY first, VisitRecordFromPhrase FROM literal, VisitRetryPhrase RETRY, VisitRecordLockPhrase WITH LOCK and DeclinedFilePhrase REWRITE FILE. Probes at --std 85: b) RECORD word, NOT INVALID KEY first, RETRY, WITH LOCK COBOL0900; FROM "LIT", FROM ZERO, FROM ALL "X" COBOL0871; FILE phrase COBOL1706; FROM twice and INVALID KEY twice COBOL2269; a WORKING-STORAGE name COBOL1757; INVALID KEY on sequential access COBOL1720 (SR3); d) FROM an S9(18) negative item gives 1234567890, FROM WE(RK), FROM WS(2:3) and FROM FUNCTION UPPER-CASE (Amendment 1) run; a) an ODO record of a RECORD VARYING file rewritten FROM an ODO group with LN 5 reads back 03XYZ; e) random, dynamic and sequential (after READ) run, keys 0 and 9999 give INVALID KEY with 23, a closed file and a file open INPUT give 49 with neither phrase run. The witness rewrites a present and an absent key FROM an item with both phrases and END-REWRITE. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming kb/Work PB5158 (landed), kb/Work PB5159 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5159 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-11.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-11-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985: "REWRITE record-name-1 [ FROM identifier-1 ] [ INVALID KEY ... ] [ NOT INVALID KEY ... ]"; 2023: "REWRITE {record-name-1 | FILE file-name-1} [FROM {identifier-1|literal-1}] [retry-phrase] [WITH LOCK|WITH NO LOCK] |INVALID KEY| |NOT INVALID KEY|". 2023 adds FILE file-name-1, FROM literal-1, retry and LOCK phrases. Its choice indicators let INVALID KEY and NOT INVALID KEY appear in either order, so more programs are accepted.
